statement:
∀ (L c : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    0 < c →
      c ≠ L →
        Tendsto (fun R => ∫ (x : ℝ) in -R..R, sin (L * x) / (π * x) * cos (c * x)) atTop
          (𝓝 (((L + c).sign + (L - c).sign) / 2))
